description: This PHP source file defines the PimReportMenuConfigurator class which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. It is part of the OrangeHRM PIM (Personal Information Management) module, specifically configuring menu items related to reports. The class utilizes a trait for module screen helper functions and overrides the current screen to 'viewDefinedPredefinedReports'.

classes.name: PimReportMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator class that sets up the PIM report menu options by overriding the current screen.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewDefinedPredefinedReports' for the provided Screen object, returning null.
